remarks: Located in the Rowayton Beach Association of Rowayton is this 3 bed 1 1/2 bath split level house available for rent.  Everything has been updated. Open floor plan with kitchen, dining area, and living room makes the house feel spacious. The living room has an electric fireplace, hardwood floors, bay window leading to the dining area with sliders to secluded patio. The kitchen has a breakfast bar, and new dishwasher, microwave. Half a flight up are three bedrooms and a full bathroom, along with pull down attic. The front door opens to the lower level with a powder room and access to garage where washer and dryer are located. Steps to Bayley Beach and all that Rowayton offers. 2 months security, excellent credit and references required.
